data.name: Aamna
data.long_meaning: Aamna is a name derived from the Arabic root عَمَنَ (amana), meaning 'to trust', 'to place reliance'. In the Islamic context, it signifies the trust and faith that one has in Allah and His guidance, as well as the trustworthiness and reliability of a person.
